title: Product of Gaussian densities along a conditional slope
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$ and $t\in\mathbb{R}$, and set $s=(1-\rho)/\sqrt{1-\rho^2}$. The product of the standard Gaussian densities at $t$ and $st$ equals $(2\pi)^{-1}\exp\!\left(-t^2/(1+\rho)\right)$.
